successors.name: Dutch East Indies
successors.text: the Sambas River and Paloh River basins, from Tanjung Datuk in the north to the Duri River in the south

ledger.x: 1609: Sambas becomes a kingdom under Sepudak.
1675: the Panembahan Ratu line becomes the Sultanate under Muhammad Shafi ud-din I, the first Muslim ruler (infobox religion 'Hinduism (until 1675)').
1819: the Dutch take control of Sambas.

wars.name: British expeditions against Sambas
wars.outcome: 'In 1812 and 1813, the British launched two military expeditions against Sambas'; the first failed and the second captured Sambas.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary: the coast and river basins are drawn from Cliopatria's outline, and the Sarawak frontier to the north is not described.
